messages:
sam: quick RFC follow-up 

sam: proposal: add a light-weight decision ledger for every precision negotiation. reason: customers can dispute quality/cost and we need an auditable trail.
leah: ledger = what fields? do we store whole prompts? privacy concern.
sam: minimal: endpoint_id, profile_version, chosen_bitpath, decision_reason_code, predicted_quality_delta_pct, trace_id, fingerprint_id (hashed), timestamp. keep prompt out of ledger, link to trace for full context.
vik: +1. also add billing_tag so finance can split savings to teams. e.g., billing_tag=org:teamA.
leah: retention policy? compliance will want short retention for hashed fingerprints but longer for trace ids.
audit-bot: recommendation: ledger rows retention = 90 days, trace retention = 180 days, hashed fingerprints = 365 days. All access audited.
sam: good. Grove: we also need a redaction flow for customers with strict PII rules. ledger should support TTL and redaction requests.
vik: how do we compute predicted_quality_delta_pct cheaply? table lookup by fingerprint bucket, fallback linear heuristic. store the method used in ledger field `estimation_method`.
leah: make `decision_reason_code` enumerated: POLICY_PREF, RUNTIME_CAPACITY, FALLBACK_UNSUPPORTED, CUSTOMER_OVERRIDE, EMERGENCY_ROLLBACK. keeps parsing simple.
sam: agreed. also include `confidence_band` (low/med/high) so disputes with low-confidence estimates get special handling (auto-escalate to shadow-eval).
ops-bot: note: PR #1102 adding ledger schema to infra is open: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1102. tests flaky on retention job.
vik: UX: console should expose a small "precision ledger" view with filters (endpoint, team, reason_code, date). add quick link to trace and to original onboarding anchor used for estimate.
leah: pilot plan: enable ledger for two internal endpoints, 10% traffic with precision profiles on. collect false positive dispute rate for 2 weeks.
sam: billing hook: when chosen_bitpath != baseline (fp16), compute token_savings_est and emit metric `precision.token_savings.{org}` so finance can backfill.
vik: edgecase: if customer calls per-call override with org_jwt claiming `allow_lowbit=true`, ledger should capture override_actor=jwt_org_id and override_ticket.
leah: security: don't log org_jwt or raw tokens in ledger. only record actor id and a redaction-safe ticket id.
sam: failure modes: if decision service unavailable, runtime must fallback to conservative path (fp16) and emit ledger row with reason_code=RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.
vik: rollback/hedging idea: for high-risk endpoints, we can hedge by sending N% of requests to alternate_bitpath (e.g., int8) and compare in shadow. ledger should mark hedged=true and hedged_compare_trace id.
leah: that helps collect empirical delta curves. plan to use this for automatic profile tuning later.
audit-bot: compliance reminder: add role-based ACL to ledger viewer; default read = eng-ml + customer-success admins only.
sam: next action items: (1) I will draft small RFC appendix with ledger schema + retention + ACLs, (2) infra: land PR #1102, (3) SDK: add header guidance for per-call override and override_ticket flow, (4) console: ledger UI spike.
vik: I'll take the SDK piece and the hedging pilot ownership.
leah: I'll draft the RFC appendix and own console spike.
ops-bot: scheduled: ledger-pilot job #221 queued (ETA ~3h).
sam: thanks all. I'll post the RFC appendix link when ready. :thumbsup:
